newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent up after Kuwait reports Iraq shooting.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent up after Kuwait reports Iraq shooting.

text.p: June Brent rose in early afternoon dealings in Asia after news that Kuwait reported an Iraqi boat shot at two Kuwaiti vessels, brokers said.
The official Kuwait News Agency reported that the emirate complained to the United Nations about an April 12 incident in which it said an Iraqi boat opened fire on two Kuwaiti vessels.
June, which was untraded in the morning session, was traded at $18.14 and $18.15 after the news with 30 lots exchanging hands. It was last traded at $18.15, up nine cents from London.

Brokers said the trades were more of a headline reaction, but the news added to worries of United Nations action against Iraq after Iraq ignored U.S. warnings not to violate the no-fly zone when it flew helicopters to the Saudi border to collect Haj pilgrims.
